name: Summer Under Glass
jem_summary: Harvest one mature crop protected by a working greenhouse roof.

pages.title: Summer Under Glass
pages.text: Harvest one mature crop protected by a working greenhouse roof.

pages.title: Summer Under Glass
pages.text: Use greenhouse protection rather than merely carrying glass.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Build an allowed glass roof above the crop within the season system’s configured greenhouse range. Winter is not required.

pages.title: Grow out of season
pages.text: Allowed overhead glass or a qualifying underground setup can provide seasonal shelter. No universal range or mandatory special Greenhouse Glass is invented.

pages.title: Pollinate seasonal crops
pages.text: Vanilla bee pollination is a separate way to help seasonal crops. Seasonal fertility and greenhouse shelter do not remove this native possibility.
